Chaince (Shenzhen) Consulting Co., Ltd. is a limited liability Prior to 2021, the Company explored various technology-related business opportunities, including blockchain-related services. Beginning in October 2021, the Company initiated digital asset mining activities as part of its exploration of blockchain infrastructure and computing services. From October 2021 to April 2022, the Company participated in Bitcoin mining through shared mining arrangements, under which the Company leased computing power from third-party mining service providers rather than owning mining equipment directly. These arrangements allowed the Company to gain operational experience in digital asset mining without significant capital investment. In December 2022, the Company expanded its digital asset activities by acquiring mining infrastructure and commencing Filecoin (“FIL”) mining operations.
